name: fast-glob
description: It's a very fast and efficient glob library for Node.js

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.watch: npm run clean && npm run compile -- -- --sourceMap --watch
scripts.bench:async: npm run bench:product:async && npm run bench:regression:async
scripts.bench:stream: npm run bench:product:stream && npm run bench:regression:stream
scripts.bench:sync: npm run bench:product:sync && npm run bench:regression:sync
scripts.bench:product: npm run bench:product:async && npm run bench:product:sync && npm run bench:product:stream
scripts.bench:regression: npm run bench:regression:async && npm run bench:regression:sync && npm run bench:regression:stream
